title: 第57章 诡异陶罐
content_zh:
第57章 诡异陶罐-《城隍是我老祖，原来我是神N代》

上一章

存书签

下一章

客套过后，苏国维就开始详细介绍家里的麻烦事。

原来，他们家是做地产生意的，前段时间，在一个工地施工的时候，挖掘机意外挖出了一口石质小棺材，大小也就只能装下小孩子的尸骨。

但是，等工地上的人员打开棺材后，却发现里面没有尸骨，只有一个陶罐，陶罐盖子上还贴着一张紫色的符箓。

看着这么邪性的东西，包工头急忙汇报给了项目负责人。

工地施工，虽然经常会挖到一些古墓什么的，但这种东西，还是第一次遇见。于是，经过层层上报，就有了两兄弟分头请人的事情。

吴姜听到这里，脸上没什么反应，他最近厉鬼都抓了好几个了，一个封着符箓的陶罐，在他看来也没什么大不了的。

可一旁的小道士，听完之后，脸色却愈发凝重起来。

吴姜不清楚紫色符箓的含义，云川道士却再清楚不过。

紫色符箓，是道家高人用来封印猛鬼级别以上邪祟的，区区厉鬼，都不配道士们掏出紫色符箓。

云川道士当即站起身，对着苏国维兄弟俩说道：“带我们去看看那个陶罐吧！速度要快，搞不好要出大问题了！”

苏国维兄弟俩不敢耽搁，连忙带着吴姜和清风道士，驱车赶往工地。

陶罐还在工地上放着，毕竟，这么邪性的东西，谁都不想带到自己家里去。

工地上依旧一片热火朝天的景象，工人们各司其职，忙碌个不停。

陶罐被放在工地的一间临时办公室里，工地负责人打开门后，小道士一马当先走在前面，其他人紧随其后进入。

一进门，就看到桌子上摆着的陶罐，一张紫色符箓封住了罐口。

吴姜和小道士同时走上前去查看，两人都是脸色一变，只见那个陶罐上，不知何时，多了一条细微的裂缝。

Chapter 57 Weird Clay Pot - "The City God is my ancestor, it turns out I am the Nth generation of gods"

After the polite remarks, Su Guowei began to introduce in detail the troubles at home.

It turns out that their family is in the real estate business. Some time ago, during construction at a construction site, an excavator accidentally dug out a small stone coffin, which was only big enough to hold the bones of a child.

However, when the workers at the construction site opened the coffin, they found that there were no bones inside, only a clay pot with a purple talisman on the lid.

Seeing such evil things, the contractor hurriedly reported it to the project leader.

Although some ancient tombs and the like are often excavated during construction sites, this is the first time I have encountered such a thing.So, after reporting it at all levels, the two brothers decided to hire someone separately.

When Wu Jiang heard this, he had no reaction on his face. He had caught several evil spirits recently, so a clay pot with a talisman sealed in it was no big deal to him.

But after listening to this, the little Taoist priest on the side became more solemn.

Wu Jiang didn't know the meaning of the purple talisman, but Taoist priest Yunchuan knew it very well.

Purple talismans are used by Taoist masters to seal evil spirits above the level of fierce ghosts. Even fierce ghosts are not worthy of Taoist priests taking out purple talismans.

Taoist priest Yunchuan immediately stood up and said to the Su Guowei brothers: "Take us to see that clay pot! We have to be fast, or there will be a big problem!"

The Su Guowei brothers did not dare to delay, and quickly drove to the construction site with Wu Jiang and Taoist Qingfeng.

The clay pot is still placed on the construction site. After all, no one wants to bring such an evil thing into their home.

The construction site is still a bustling scene, with workers performing their duties and busy non-stop.

The clay pot was placed in a temporary office at the construction site. After the construction site manager opened the door, the little Taoist priest took the lead and followed closely.

As soon as he entered the door, he saw a clay pot on the table, with a purple talisman sealing the mouth of the pot.

Wu Jiang and the little Taoist priest stepped forward to check at the same time. Their expressions changed, and they saw that there was a slight crack on the pottery pot at some point.
